text: Evening. My son is 2 and he's had a temperature today, 38.2 when I checked about twenty minutes ago with the ear thermometer. Mainly I'm after a dosing question. We've got infant paracetamol (the 120mg/5ml sachets) and infant ibuprofen (100mg/5ml) in the cupboard and I want to double check how much of each he can have and how often, and whether it's fine to give one and then the other if the first doesn't bring it down. He's about 13kg if that matters. For context he's been at his nan's all day, out at the park twice and missed his nap, so he's currently flopped on the sofa looking like he's done a shift down the mines. I gave him a nudge just now to see, and he woke straight up and started telling me all about the ducks and asking for his cup, so he's just knackered rather than anything else. He's had his tea and a drink. I'll probably carry him up shortly, just want to know whether to give him a dose first and how much. Thanks.
